answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake and earn peer attestations over several epochs before it can vouch for others. A sybil farmer must pay that stake per fake identity and wait out probation, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds plus time, while an honest newcomer pays once. Trust must not become a relic granting permanent power: decay scores of inactive agents, so no haven for dormant accounts forms. Admit newcomers through a narrow inlet, only a few per epoch, making a flood slow and visible before it can outvote honest agents.
